mmt_note.label: MMT note
mmt_note.text: Government payments create net financial assets; taxes destroy them; JGB/T-Bill issuance drains reserves without changing that stock. The daily BoJ factor nets all of it — the MoF monthly Excel attributes it.

alerts.action_hint: |Z| ≥ 2 = extraordinary daily flow (tax day, JGB settlement, pension, FX intervention)
weak super-long demand feeds the QT_STRESS overlay
wide tail = dealers demanded concession; ≥ 6 bp STRESS, ≥ 12 bp CRISIS (May-2025 20Y type event)
